title: Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026 Review: East Java's Full Marathon with Open Registration
seo_title: Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026 Review | East Java Indonesia
meta_description: The Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026: October 4 in Surabaya. 42K, 21K, 10K, 5K with early-bird registration open — Indonesia's second-city full marathon reviewed.
dek: Set for 4 October 2026 in Surabaya, East Java, this ISOPLUS-branded marathon offers four distances with early-bird registration open. A full marathon in Indonesia's second-largest city.
verdict: The Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon brings a full 42.195km to Surabaya — Indonesia's City of Heroes and the country's second-largest metropolitan area. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K) with early-bird registration open. Surabaya is a major running hub with a passionate local community, and the ISOPLUS isotonic-drink brand backing ensures well-stocked hydration stations. October in Surabaya is the dry-season tail — warm but manageable with an early-morning start. For runners wanting a full marathon in Indonesia's great second city, this is the pick.

sections.heading: Surabaya: Indonesia's City of Heroes
